title: Mobile Check Deposit: Troubleshooting a Rejected Deposit
body: If a mobile check deposit is rejected, the most common causes are a missing or incorrect endorsement, a blurry photo of the check, or a stale-dated check (older than six months). Rejected deposits are not charged against your deposit limit. Re-take the photo in good lighting on a dark, flat surface and confirm the endorsement includes 'For Mobile Deposit Only' before resubmitting. If the issue persists, deposit the check in person at a branch or ATM instead.
